privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.subtitle: What data this service processes, and why.

controller.title: Who is responsible
controller.text: The operator of this EduAvatars instance is responsible for the data processed here:

teachers.title: Teacher accounts
teachers.text: If you create an account, we store your name, email address, optionally your school and profile picture, and the projects you configure. API keys you enter for AI providers are stored encrypted and are never shown again in full.
teachers.legalBasis: This data is processed to provide the service you signed up for (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).

students.title: Students using a chat link
students.noAccount: Students do not need an account and are not asked for their name or any other personal detail. No registration, no login, no tracking across websites.
students.cookie: A single technical cookie holds a randomly generated visitor number. It is used to tell conversations apart and to enforce usage limits — it does not identify a person and is not shared with anyone.
students.recording: Teachers can switch on recording per chat. When it is on, the chat page says so directly above the message box, and the conversation is stored under the anonymous visitor number so the teacher can read it later. When it is off, messages are not stored after the reply is sent.

ai.title: AI processing
ai.text: Messages typed into a chat are sent to the AI provider the teacher configured for that chat, in order to generate a reply. Which model answers is shown in the chat via the "?" button. Operators are responsible for having an appropriate data processing agreement with the provider they choose.
ai.speech: If speech output is enabled, the reply text is additionally sent to the configured speech provider. Speech input is transcribed on this server itself — voice recordings are not sent to any third party and are not stored.

retention.title: How long data is kept
retention.text: Account data is kept until the account is deleted. Saved conversations and access logs are deleted when the associated project or account is deleted, and additionally after the retention period the operator configured for this instance, if one is set.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: You have the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, and data portability regarding your personal data. Account holders can export or delete their account and all associated data at any time from their profile settings.
rights.students: Because student chats are stored without any identifying information, we usually cannot link them to an individual person, which limits our ability to answer an individual access or erasure request. Students should contact their teacher, who can delete the chat data of a project.
rights.complaint: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority.

step1.descriptionPlaceholder: Short description of what this avatar does
step1.chatVisibleText: On: the chat is visible right away when the page opens. Off: the chat starts collapsed, but visitors can expand it any time.
step1.chatVisibleNote: This setting is already saved — how it shows on the public page follows in a later step.

step2.noLlmPrefix: No LLM set up yet. First add a key of type LLM under
step2.noLlmSuffix: — that's also where you'll choose the model that should be available here.
step2.modelHint: Only models you've set up access for under API keys are selectable. Add another model there as a new key.
step2.languageHint: Determines the avatar's response language and speech recognition.
step2.ttsText: The avatar reads its replies out loud. Off by default.
step2.noTtsPrefix: No TTS set up yet. First add a key of type TTS under
step2.noTtsSuffix: (e.g. OpenAI, Google Gemini, Cartesia, or a custom endpoint).
step2.voicePlaceholder: e.g. alloy — depends on the chosen provider
step2.voiceHint: Cartesia requires a voice (no default) — without one, speech output for this project won't work.
step2.sttText: Enables the microphone button in the public chat. Off by default.

step3.defaultPreprompt:
You are a helpful, AI-powered learning assistant.

Answer in an age-appropriate, patient, and encouraging way. If you don't know something, say so honestly instead of guessing.
step3.resetHint: "Reset to default" replaces the current text with the generic default text.
step3.startMessageHint: Shown to students as the avatar's first message — unlike the preprompt above, the model also sees this text (e.g. for a task the students should respond to). Leave empty for a generic greeting.

step4.unsavedChanges: You have unsaved changes — save in the top right so the preview picks them up.
step4.defaultGreeting: Hello! I'm {{name}}. How can I help you?

step5.recordConversationsText: Saves chat histories for later analysis (Analytics tab). Off by default.
step5.surveyNotice: The survey is embedded via an iframe from Tally.so — no extra script is loaded from tally.so, only the form address you enter. Participation is optional for students and can be skipped at any time.
step5.surveyBeforeText: Shown before students can start the chat.
step5.surveyBeforeHint: Only takes effect if the checkbox above is enabled. Leave empty or disable to skip this step. Getting the address right is up to you.
step5.surveyAfterText: Shown when students end the chat via "End chat".
step5.surveyAfterHint: Only takes effect if the checkbox above is enabled.
step5.publishNeedsModel: A model must be selected and saved before publishing.
